transformations: Retain eight selected actual tick payloads and actual measured video mappings for those ticks and their successors.

Retain eight selected actual snapshots with exact consumed player fields, generic NPCs, required combat and strict-replay sections, mouse diagnostics and all raw/settled lineage. Remove unrelated player/profile/skill state; redact strings in ancillary players/widgets/quest sections. Their actual numeric/boolean state and collection sizes remain unchanged.
Translate world x/y and scene bases by one constant vector to base3200/3200, retaining selected scene coordinates, distances, tile flags, planes, canvas operands and numeric raw payload hashes.
Pseudonymize session/producer/event IDs consistently and translate stable NPC coordinate IDs.
Shift absolute clock timestamps together to2000-01-01, retaining durations, offsets, measured uncertainty and settlement tick delays.

No events, actions, positions, proof, timing measurements or media frames are invented; no pixels, account names, private token, original absolute positions or actual login timestamps are distributed.
Redact NPC interactingPlayerName and any remaining exact source display-name strings; generic NPC names and interaction indices are preserved.
